body:
Cammy_G, a mod on Avicus, banned me for standing up for ThadRocks123. There was a misconception that I was 17301567 was ThadRocks123 alternative account. I was banned for no reason other then saying that I think ThadRocks123 should be unbanned. I believe I should be unbanned from the mczone server because I did not do anything. The only allocation I have with ThadRocks123, is that I am his sister. That's all. I am very angry at this server ad it's moderators and would like a response to this very thorough complaint.

-17301567
